headline: Normas ISO 14000 y responsabilidad social empresarial
content: - Hoy en día no solo cuentan factores como la calidad y el precio de los productos y servicios que se ofrecen para ganarse un lugar en la mente y el corazón de los consumidores. También importa el modo en que impactan sus acciones en el ecosistema.  - Nos referimos a un movimiento profundo y a una transformación en la actitud de las empresas, para adecuar sus objetivos y metas, sus políticas y procesos, en favor del medio ambiente.  - Todos estos aspectos se engloban en la familia de normas ISO 14000, establecidas por la Organización Internacional para la Normalización (ISO).  - Dentro de esta familia, la que establece los requisitos de certificación es la ISO 14001.

Respect for recreational marijuana use in Mexico
content: The president of Mexico, Enrique Peña Nieto, assured Wednesday night that his government respects and recognizes decisions made by the Supreme Court of Justice of the Nation (SCJN), including those related to approving the recreational and non-profit use of cannabis.  In a series of messages through Twitter, Peña Nieto stated that the criterion expressed [by the SCJN] opens up a discussion about the best regulation to inhibit drug consumption, which is a public health issue. Its known that last week, the SCJN authorized cultivation, possession, and consumption of marijuana for recreational purposes throughout the country.

headline: How to gain muscle mass without weights?
content: It’s possible to build muscles even without using dumbbells, says Vanna Glorio, coach at Vanna Coach Center. There are always ways to achieve what we want—it just takes determination, discipline, and information.  Glory admits it wont be easy since gyms equipped with machines or free weights make building muscle more controlled and straightforward. However, she emphasizes that home workouts sans equipment are also viable. To succeed, apply progressive overload capable of stimulating cell growth effectively while maintaining proper technique during exercises designed intelligently alongside a voluminous diet rich in proteins and complex carbohydrates.

headline: Mexico respects court ruling on marijuana
content: President Enrique Peña Nieto has publicly acknowledged respect towards the recent judicial rulings regarding the legalization of recreational marijuana usage within Mexican borders. This stance was communicated following statements released over various platforms such as Twitter where emphasis was placed upon adhering to legal frameworks established by higher courts like the Supreme Judicial Council of National Affairs (SCJN).  This development comes amidst broader debates concerning regulatory measures aimed at reducing substance abuse—a matter considered crucial under national healthcare policies.
